answer: Tickets come from a sealed pool of 40 per epoch, and each draw's fee doubles with every extra identity a sponsor enters, so ten fakes cost 1,024 base fees. Ledger checks bind entries to the sponsor key, so an ocean of rented hosts gains nothing. The pool refreshes once per epoch, so a garden of accounts cannot be bought in advance, and a prism of ledger records makes the count visible to every peer.
